beats.summary: Pam and Jim express happiness about being in the same city for Valentine's Day and plan a romantic lunch with friends.

evidence.snippet: Pam (to Jim): Hey. I feel so lucky we're in the same city for Valentine's Day.
Pam: Oh, hey, don't fill up on chocolates. I made us a lunch reservation at State Street Grill.

beats.summary: Erin plans to break up with Andy, who is returning from a boat trip, and wants to spend the day having fun with Pete.

evidence.snippet: Erin: I really wanna have fun today because tomorrow is going to be a nightmare. Andy's coming back from his stupid, dumb boat trip.
Pete: Erin says she's gonna break up with Andy, but I'm not sure.

beats.summary: Dwight pretends to be Andy to manage Andy's work tasks while Andy is away.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (pretending to be Andy): I would be happy to. It would be my pleasure, Mr. Schrute.
Dwight: I really like Andy these days. He's pretend and he does exactly as I tell him to.

beats.summary: Office employees plan to take advantage of Valentine's Day couples discounts by pairing off with fake partners.

evidence.snippet: Phyllis: Or the mini mall. They have all these Valentine Day deals. You can get 20% off if you come in with your husband or your boyfriend.
Nellie: Everyone, it is our last day here with no manager. I say we go to the mini mall. Clark, you will be my fake boyfriend so I can get the discount.

beats.summary: Clark refuses to continue pretending to be Nellie's boyfriend after being teased by nail stylists.

evidence.snippet: Clark: Oh, you guys think this is funny? You know what? No more discount. Excuse me. Full price. We're not together.
Nellie: Turns out, I can't even be in a pretend relationship.

beats.summary: Oscar and Darryl are denied a couples discount at a nail salon because they are both men, leading them to leave in protest.

evidence.snippet: Nail manager: No. No discount for two men. Two men are not a couple.
Darryl: Oh, it works. Him and me, all right, we are crazy in love.
